reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: update_referral_params is called from entry_points/admin/referral.move:46 (non-test caller). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions table in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json, cannot lookup. Gate 3: contracts/protocol/sources/internal/referral.move is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is clear — individual bps values are validated against DENOMINATOR (L250-251) but their combined sum is never checked, violating the invariant referrer_bps + referee_bps < 10000. Attack path requires an AdminCap holder to deliberately pass extreme values (e.g. referrer=9000, referee=9000), which is a privileged-role precondition making the attack path uncertain rather than directly attacker-triggered.
